day_shape: US-Iran peace deal announced overnight with reported 14-point draft and $24bn frozen-asset release, E4+ leaders welcome it, Israel refuses Lebanon withdrawal, IRIB says Strait of Hormuz closed 96+ hours, IDF killed Hezbollah's Ali Musa Daqduq.

threads.label: US-Iran peace deal announced
threads.summary: The US and Iran announced a preliminary agreement to end their war, with Trump saying Hormuz would reopen and reports of a 14-point draft including $24bn in frozen assets released during 60-day talks. The UK PM issued a response and a Joint E4 Leaders' Statement (UK, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Canada, Australia) welcomed the deal; UN Secretary-General Guterres called it a 'critical step'.

threads.label: Israeli reaction and Lebanon posture
threads.summary: Defence Minister Israel Katz said the IDF would not withdraw from southern Lebanon, Syria or Gaza despite the ceasefire framework, with Ben-Gvir and other ministers refusing to concede sovereignty. Trump reportedly told the New York Times Netanyahu almost derailed the deal and called him a 'very difficult guy', and said attacks could resume if no nuclear deal is reached.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz closure and shipping
threads.summary: IRIB claimed the Sepah Navy had issued no transit permits for over 96 hours and that the Strait of Hormuz remained closed to all vessels, while CENTCOM said it had redirected 142 commercial ships and disabled 9 as part of its blockade. The Jerusalem Post reported mine-clearance could delay normal shipping by weeks even after the reopening deal.

threads.label: Lebanon strikes and Hezbollah fire
threads.summary: The IDF announced it killed senior Hezbollah commander Ali Musa Daqduq in a precision strike in southern Lebanon, and reported a Hezbollah drone intercepted before midnight and a rocket barrage near Neot Mordechai that wounded two soldiers. An Israeli drone strike hit a car in Kfar Tebnit and artillery shelled Nabatieh al-Fawqa.

threads.label: Regime resilience and resistance messaging
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried heavy messaging on national unity and victory, including Army chief General Hatami's remarks on 'martyr commander Bagheri' and the 12 and 40-day wars, Ayatollah Nouri Hamedani warning against discord, and Khamenei's office posting a message marking the 37th anniversary of Imam Khomeini's death. Defa Press published commentary on the 14-point draft, framing it as a 'political understanding' rather than a final agreement.

threads.label: Iranian domestic economy and weather
threads.summary: IRIB reported Central Bank figures showing liquidity grew 47.3% year-on-year to 14,640 trillion toman and that phase-184 cash subsidies had been transferred to first-to-third decile households, while the Vice President warned of industrial shutdowns without a 10% cut in electricity use. The Meteorological Organisation issued an orange alert for West and East Azerbaijan and Ardabil.

threads.label: Iran at the World Cup
threads.summary: Iran's World Cup squad arrived in the US and left its Tijuana base ahead of its opener against New Zealand in Los Angeles. Times of Israel reported Iranian Americans planning both watch parties and protests, and Jerusalem Post cited an Iranian source saying regime opponents were 'shocked' by emerging details of the US-Iran agreement.

In countering these ill wishes (the enemy's hybrid warfare) everyone must, with steadfastness and clear-sightedness and by preserving unity and cohesion and mutual trust and not echoing the enemy, neutralise his sinister plan.
